cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:d4.title: General Manager
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:d4.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. The General Manager is responsible for overseeing the comprehensive management of Finance, Human Resources, Operations, Quality Control, and Safety within the organization. This role requires a strategic leader who can drive operational efficiency, ensure financial integrity, foster a positive workplace culture, and maintain high standards of quality and safety. The General Manager will work collaboratively across departments to achieve organizational goals and deliver exceptional value to stakeholders.
responsibilities: Strategic Oversight:
Develop and implement strategic initiatives that align with the company’s goals across all functional areas.
Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to inform strategic planning and decision-making.
Financial Management:
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting to ensure financial health and accountability.
Implement financial controls and risk management strategies to safeguard the organization’s assets.
Collaborate with the finance team to analyze financial performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Human Resources Leadership:
Develop and implement HR strategies that attract, develop, and retain top talent.
Foster a culture of engagement, inclusion, and professional development.
Ensure compliance with labor laws and regulations, and manage employee relations effectively.
Operational Excellence:
Streamline operations to improve efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness.
Implement best practices in project management and operational processes.
Oversee supply chain management, procurement, and logistics to optimize resource utilization.
Quality Control:
Establish and enforce quality standards and processes to ensure product/service excellence.
Monitor and analyze quality metrics, implementing corrective actions as necessary.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement through training and development initiatives.
Safety Management:
Develop and implement safety policies and programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
Promote a culture of safety throughout the organization, ensuring all employees are trained and informed.
Monitor safety performance and implement corrective actions to minimize incidents and risks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among all departments to achieve strategic objectives.
Serve as a liaison between different functional areas, ensuring alignment and synergy.
Stakeholder Engagement:
Represent the organization in meetings with clients, partners, and regulatory agencies.
Communicate effectively with the CEO and Board of Directors on key initiatives, challenges, and opportunities.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficient in financial analysis, budgeting, and reporting.
Knowledge of quality assurance methodologies and safety regulations.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:965d1287-5b32-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Manager – Brand & Organic Growth based in United Kingdom. This role offers the opportunity to become a highly visible voice for a growing portfolio of digital brands within the iGaming and affiliate marketing space. You will shape brand presence across industry events, conferences, social media, and digital channels. The position combines relationship building, content creation, event marketing, and organic growth initiatives. You will build meaningful connections with industry stakeholders, media, partners, and other influential contacts. Working closely with SEO, content, and affiliate teams, you will turn events and social activity into measurable brand visibility and organic reach. This is a dynamic role for a charismatic marketer who enjoys representing brands publicly and creating opportunities for recognition and growth. Represent the brands at industry events, expos, conferences, networking opportunities, and other relevant gatherings, acting as a confident and engaging public representative. Create original and engaging content, including photos, videos, interviews, stories, and industry insights, to capture event experiences and strengthen digital presence. Collaborate with SEO, content, affiliate, and other internal teams to maximize the impact of social media, events, and brand-building initiatives. Proactively identify and pursue speaking engagements, panel discussions, interviews, media opportunities, and other activities that can strengthen brand credibility and industry recognition. Monitor and analyze the performance of social and event initiatives, using insights to improve brand visibility, organic growth, and audience engagement. Stay informed about industry developments, emerging trends, and relevant opportunities that can contribute to stronger brand positioning and organic reach. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the charisma and confidence to act as a visible representative at industry events and across digital channels. Proven ability to build and maintain authentic professional relationships and develop a strong industry network organically. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c20fd619-e826-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Legal Manager (Freelance) based in Portugal. This role offers an opportunity for an experienced legal professional to take ownership of key legal activities within a growing, technology-driven organization. You will help ensure that business operations remain compliant with applicable laws, regulations, and contractual obligations. The position combines legal management, strategic advisory work, risk assessment, and cross-functional collaboration. You will provide practical guidance to leadership while helping the organization navigate corporate and operational legal matters. The role requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear business recommendations. As a freelance professional, you will have the autonomy to manage priorities while contributing directly to the organization’s legal strategy and risk management. This is a strong opportunity for a seasoned legal professional seeking a flexible engagement with meaningful organizational impact. Manage and coordinate day-to-day legal activities, ensuring that legal matters are handled efficiently and in accordance with applicable requirements. Provide strategic and practical legal advice to leadership and relevant stakeholders on corporate and operational matters. Monitor applicable laws, regulations, and legal developments and assess their potential impact on business activities. Support the organization in maintaining compliance with relevant legal and regulatory obligations. Review, draft, and advise on contracts, agreements, policies, and other legal documentation as required. Identify potential legal risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies to protect the organization’s interests. Collaborate with internal teams and external legal professionals when specialized advice or additional legal support is required. Help establish and maintain effective legal processes, documentation, and governance practices. Provide clear, commercially minded recommendations that enable the organization to make informed business decisions. Requirements Proven experience as a legal professional, Legal Manager, Corporate Counsel, or in a comparable legal leadership role. Strong background in corporate law and experience advising organizations on a range of business-related legal matters. Solid understanding of applicable legal and regulatory frameworks, with the ability to identify and address compliance risks. Experience reviewing and drafting contracts, agreements, policies, and other corporate legal documents. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail. Ability to provide clear, practical, and commercially focused legal advice to senior stakeholders. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple legal matters and competing priorities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong professional judgment, discretion, and integrity when handling sensitive legal and business matters. Ability to work independently and effectively as a freelance professional in a flexible, remote environment. Relevant legal qualifications and authorization to practice law in the applicable jurisdiction. Benefits Freelance engagement with a flexible, part-time structure. Remote working arrangement. Opportunity to take ownership of important legal and compliance activities. Strategic exposure to a growing, technology-driven marketplace. Ability to work closely with leadership and contribute to business-level decision-making. Flexible environment suited to experienced legal professionals seeking autonomy. Opportunity to apply corporate legal expertise to innovative, globally oriented business operations. ryzlabs-ryzlabs:lever:6ec18bec-1124-412f.description: Mostly remote position (cowork once a week) - From Buenos Aires, Argentina Ryz Labs is looking for an Engineering Manager to join our client's fast-moving team, and help shape the next chapter of their project. You will build, mentor, and scale a high-impact engineering team, playing a key role in shaping their technical direction, improving engineering excellence, and ensuring they deliver reliable, elegant products at speed. This role is expected to be highly travel-intensive, particularly in the first few months, so a valid U.S. Travel Visa is required. Key Responsibilities: - Lead, mentor, and coach engineers across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. - Partner with other leads to define priorities, scope projects, and support effective planning. - Facilitate architectural discussions and provide technical direction. - Lead AI integration for the project, and the building of new AI tools to increase speed and efficiency. - Ensure strong engineering practices around code quality, testing, documentation, and reliability. - Oversee project execution: unblock teams, manage timelines, and coordinate cross-functional efforts. - Support team growth through hiring, onboarding, and building a high-performing, inclusive culture. - Run and refine engineering processes, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and 1:1s. - Drive continuous improvements in velocity, collaboration, technical excellence, and communication. - Collaborate with leadership to define long-term technical strategy and scaling plans. - Advocate for the team and manage expectations across stakeholders. Qualifications: - 5+ years of experience in engineering management or technical leadership roles. - Valid U.S. Travel Visa and passport, since trips to NYC will be expected, especially in the first few months of the role (costs will be covered by the company) - Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, architectures, and delivery workflows across web or platform teams. - Ability to provide technical direction, review engineering decisions, and guide system design. - Proven success in hiring, managing, mentoring, and developing engineers across multiple seniority levels. - Strong communication, facilitation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with product, design, and business partners. - Experience leading teams in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where priorities, processes, and systems evolve rapidly. - Ability to balance execution speed, technical quality, and long-term strategic thinking Desired Qualifications: - Experience with distributed systems, DevOps practices, or cloud architectures at a conceptual level. - Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and reliability best practices. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world. soniresources-soniresources:lever:422115.title: Business Development Director - New Jersey Technology Practice
soniresources-soniresources:lever:422115.description: At Soni Resources Group, we’re not just another staffing firm—we’re a fast-growing, data-driven team revolutionizing how businesses access top-tier talent. Since our founding in 2016, we’ve built a reputation for innovative solutions, strategic thinking, and unparalleled client relationships. With offices in 10 locations across 7 states, Soni is expanding rapidly and seeking a Business Development Director to lead and grow our New Jersey Technology Practice as a player-coach, driving both strategic leadership and hands-on business development. About the Role The Business Development Director for our New Jersey Technology Practice is a dynamic leadership role combining strategic oversight with active client acquisition and team mentorship. As a player-coach, you’ll spearhead outbound sales initiatives, forge meaningful client relationships, and guide a team of business development professionals to success in the fast-paced technology staffing market. This role is ideal for a seasoned sales leader with a passion for technology, a proven track record in outbound sales, and the ability to inspire and develop a high-performing team.
responsibilities: Lead Business Development Strategy : Design and execute a comprehensive outbound sales strategy to expand Soni’s footprint in the New Jersey technology market, targeting key accounts and generating demand for our talent solutions.
Client Acquisition : Proactively identify, engage, and secure new clients through targeted outreach, relationship-building, and strategic account mapping.
Team Leadership & Mentorship : Coach and mentor a team of business development associates, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and results-driven performance.
Hands-On Sales Execution : Actively participate in outbound sales efforts, leveraging your expertise to close high-value deals and model best practices for the team.
Market Expertise : Stay ahead of trends in the technology sector to position Soni as a trusted partner for clients seeking specialized talent.
Collaboration : Partner with recruitment teams to align client needs with candidate pipelines, ensuring seamless delivery of talent solutions.
Performance Metrics : Drive measurable outcomes, including revenue growth, client acquisition, and team performance, while utilizing data-driven insights to optimize strategies.
qualifications: Experience : 5+ years of experience in business development or sales, with at least 2 years in a leadership or player-coach role, preferably in technology staffing or recruitment.
Proven Track Record : Demonstrated success in outbound sales, with a history of securing high-value clients and exceeding revenue targets.
Leadership Skills : Strong ability to mentor, motivate, and develop a team while fostering a collaborative and high-energy environment.
Industry Knowledge : Deep understanding of the technology sector, including key roles, trends, and talent needs in the New York market.
Communication : Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence C-level stakeholders.
Data-Driven Mindset : Comfortable using CRM tools and data analytics to track performance, identify opportunities, and optimize strategies.
Education : Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field; advanced degree or certifications a plus.

southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:3e.title: People Operations
southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:3e.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. ABOUT THE ROLE We're growing fast and bringing in world-class talent from around the globe, and we're doing it differently than most. That kind of momentum doesn't run itself. We're hiring someone to build the engine behind it: the HR processes, playbooks, and systems that can scale as fast as we do. This is a rare chance to own real scope early. You'll help build and run our core HR functions from the ground up, including onboarding, benefits, compensation, compliance, and employee relations. You'll also own our immigration program end to end. Along the way you'll solve hard problems, work cases that actually matter to people's lives, and watch the things you build become how the company runs. In this role you will: - Support global mobility and international expansion, helping evaluate and operationalize employee moves across countries and building the People infrastructure required as Cognition enters new markets. - Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees navigating immigration, including visa sponsorship, renewals, status changes, travel considerations, and other immigration-related questions; manage US immigration end to end (H-1B, O-1, PERM, green cards) in close coordination with outside counsel. - Drive process design and continuous improvement across the employee lifecycle, identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve how the People team operates. - Bring an operational lens to business decisions, surfacing risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and helping leaders navigate complex People situations with strong judgment. - Jump into high-priority People and business projects as needed. We are a lean team operating in a rapidly evolving company, so the scope of this role will continue to expand alongside Cognition. Requirements for this role: - 3+ years in people operations or HR at a fast-growing startup or tech company - Solid generalist foundation across core HR: onboarding, benefits administration, compliance, employee relations, and policy - Practical experience managing US immigration cases (H-1B, O-1, PERM, green cards), including direct coordination with outside counsel EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any.

thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.title: Gastroenterology Physician, Stamford, CT
thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - Connecticut Gastroenterology (CTGI) - powered by GI Alliance. As a member of GI Alliance (GIA), Connecticut Gastroenterology (CTGI) is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven gastroenterology network that is physician-led. This partnership empowers Connecticut Gastroenterology (CTGI) to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging GI Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our physicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Practice Opportunities: Employed Position with Partnership Track Local Autonomy with National Resources Generous Financial Package Relocation Allowance, Signing Bonus & Annual CME Great Work/Life Balance Lifestyle: Close proximity to major cities like New York City, Boston, and Providence. Several historic towns across the state. Top-tier dining and culinary scene. Top-Notch Public Schools Practice Model Guaranteed base salary with productivity bonus for first 2 years 3rd year partnership track with ASC ownership buy-in potential, additional ancillary income, and restricted stock grant Shared Call with group Good blend of clinic and hospital Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com . In this role, you will review pre-seeded questions paired with images and provide accurate "golden" answers based on what you observe in the image. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are meticulous, and able to follow detailed instructions consistently. What You'll Do Review a pre-seeded question along with an accompanying image (e.g., "What is the title of the Excel file based on what you see in the image?")
